project_type: Next.js 14 App Router multi-tenant SaaS (WhatsApp Business messaging), TypeScript, route handlers returning NextResponse
build_system: npm + Next.js 14; build runs `prisma generate` then `next build`. Prisma 5 with driverAdapters preview feature + @prisma/adapter-libsql over Turso/libSQL (SQLite). No bundler quirks beyond Next inlining NEXT_PUBLIC_* at build time.
test_framework: NONE installed. No test runner, no tsx. The only automated check is `npm run build` plus a plain Node script `scripts/test-crypto.mjs` run with `node` (no import from TS, no compile).
test_command: npm run build && ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32) node scripts/test-crypto.mjs
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run db:push` applies new nullable WhatsAppNumber columns to live Turso (additive, no data loss). 2) `npm run build` (prisma generate && next build) must pass with no type/build errors. 3) `ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32) node scripts/test-crypto.mjs` asserts encrypt/decrypt round-trip, tamper-throws, absent/short-key-throws. 4) Webhook GET handshake via curl (matching verify token -> exact hub.challenge/200; wrong -> 403). 5) Webhook POST: sign a crafted raw body with HMAC-SHA256(test secret) -> matching Message updated by metaMessageId; missing/invalid X-Hub-Signature-256 -> 401 and no rows. Live Meta OAuth/send/delivery require a Meta Config ID + App Review + real token (user-supplied) and are 'needs runtime verification' — the coder verifies handler shape, zod rejects, and 400/409/500 branches by reading the compiled route, and must NOT dismiss user-reported symptoms as 'already working' from code alone.
snapshot_or_generated_files: `prisma generate` produces the Prisma client (regenerated by `npm run build`; not committed as source). `scripts/test-crypto.mjs` is a committed test harness, not generated. No other generated/checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: db:push targets the LIVE Turso DB (TURSO_DATABASE_URL/TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN) — changes are additive/nullable only, never drop a column. Live Meta Graph calls (v19.0) need real credentials + a Meta-side Config ID and App Review that are user-supplied and out of code scope; such paths cannot be exercised end-to-end here. `openssl` is used to generate ENCRYPTION_KEY. Do NOT put real secrets in .env.example or logs.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering found. Global rule in effect: scratchpad.md at repo root MUST be kept current and get a dated change-log entry in the SAME change (handled in FEAT-004). Never log or return decrypted tokens/secrets; reference secrets by key name only. Zero new npm dependencies.
key_patterns: Route handlers: `import { getServerSession } from "next-auth"`, `import { authOptions } from "@/lib/auth"`, `import prisma from "@/lib/db"` (DEFAULT export), return `NextResponse.json(...)`. Every authenticated route 401s without session.user.id and scopes queries by `userId: session.user.id`. Superadmin check: `session.user.role === "superadmin"`. zod already available for validation. Node crypto imported as `import crypto from "crypto"` (see payments/verify). Graph API version is v19.0 in all fetch URLs. Phone normalization everywhere: `s.replace(/\D/g, "")`. WhatsAppNumber unique key is `phoneNumber` ONLY (no compound unique) — onboarding uses find-then-branch, NOT Prisma upsert.
